# coolify_server_domains (Data Source)

The domains served by a server, grouped by IP — useful for DNS automation.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "coolify_server_domains" "main" {
  server_uuid = data.coolify_server.main.uuid
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `server_uuid` (String) UUID of the server.

### Read-Only

- `domains` (Attributes List) Domains grouped by IP. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--domains))

<a id="nestedatt--domains"></a>
### Nested Schema for `domains`

Read-Only:

- `domains` (List of String) Domains served from this IP.
- `ip` (String) IP address.
